req.title: Content-Type is JSON
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /players endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that all /players endpoints must return a Content-Type of application/json when a body is returned. This ensures that clients can correctly parse the response. The test suite includes positive, negative, and boundary cases to verify compliance with this requirement.

tests.name: test_get_all_players_content_type_json
preconditions: The /players/ endpoint is available and returns a body.
actions: Send a GET request to the /players/ endpoint.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/json'

tests.name: test_get_player_by_invalid_id_content_type_json
actions: Send a GET request to the /players/{player_id} endpoint with an invalid UUID.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
invalid_uuid = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
response = client.get(f'/players/{invalid_uuid}')
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/json'

tests.name: test_post_player_boundary_content_type_json
preconditions: The /players/ endpoint is available for POST requests.
actions: Send a POST request to the /players/ endpoint with a boundary-valid payload.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
boundary_payload = {
    "firstName": "A",
    "middleName": "A",
    "lastName": "A",
    "dateOfBirth": "A",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Goalkeeper",
    "abbrPosition": "GK",
    "team": "Manchester City",
    "league": "Premier League",
    "starting11": True
}
response = client.post('/players/', json=boundary_payload)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/json'
